- **PivX** may audit Detto’s books and records. [ADIANUTRITION,INC_04_01_2005-EX-10.D2-RESELLER AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **NAI** may have independent auditors audit Co-Host’s accounting records. [BEYONDCOMCORP_08_03_2000-EX-10.2-CO-HOSTING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 9]
- **Each party** may commission an audit concerning Retail Impressions or CNET Sales. [CYBERIANOUTPOSTINC_07_09_1998-EX-10.13-PROMOTION AGREEMENT.PDF p. 4]
- **Rogers** may audit Licensor’s records for compliance with the favorable-terms provision. [EuromediaHoldingsCorp_20070215_10SB12G_EX-10.B(01)_525118_EX-10.B(01)_Content License Agreement.pdf p. 8]
- **Go Call** may examine PageMaster’s books and records to verify promotional sales. [GOCALLINC_03_30_2000-EX-10.7-Promotion Agreement.PDF p. 2]
- **Either party** may audit the other’s agreement-related books and records. [HealthcentralCom_19991108_S-1A_EX-10.27_6623292_EX-10.27_Co-Branding Agreement.pdf p. 4]
- **JRVS** may audit Distributor’s books and records to verify reports. [ImineCorp_20180725_S-1_EX-10.5_11275970_EX-10.5_Distributor Agreement.pdf p. 2]
- **VerticalNet** may appoint an accountant to audit Impresse’s payment-related financial records. [ImpresseCorp_20000322_S-1A_EX-10.11_5199234_EX-10.11_Co-Branding Agreement.pdf p. 4]
- **ALFA AESAR** may commission an audit of NTC’s referral-related invoices and accounting records. [NANOPHASETECHNOLOGIESCORP_11_01_2005-EX-99.1-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF p. 5]
- **NetGrocer** may appoint an accountant to inspect Excite’s payment-related records. [NETGROCERINC_07_31_1998-EX-10.15-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF p. 5]
- **E.piphany** may audit HSNS’s business records for contractual compliance. [OASYSMOBILE,INC_07_05_2001-EX-10.17-OUTSOURCING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **Cisco’s audit rights** are expressly referenced and extended to Distributor’s compliance representations. [ScansourceInc_20190822_10-K_EX-10.39_11793959_EX-10.39_Distributor Agreement.pdf p. 2]
- **Owner** may audit Operator’s records and relevant contractor records. [VERTEXENERGYINC_08_14_2014-EX-10.24-OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 15]
